name: @commitscape/builder
description: The Builder: takes Builds from the queue, runs commitscape on a clone, and stores the Report in R2.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/builder.mjs --external:@resvg/resvg-js --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
